"great armies meet," but only after something uncomfortable has been said out loud. So this isn't a day for quietly smoothing things over; it's a day for a direct, named, visible conversation, and to expect the first exchange to feel awkward before it feels good.

The Abysmal has you in its grip ? this is a time of genuine peril, not mere discomfort. Your DAO is navigating treacherous waters where trust is thin and every step feels like a potential fall. Yet the hexagram promises that sincerity, not clever strategy, is the only way through. The changing lines point to a hidden gathering force (hexagram 45) that will coalesce around those who act with integrity, not those who posture.
